constraints.name: spotlight_answer_revisions_answering_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (answering_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: spotlight_answer_revisions_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: spotlight_answer_revisions_reused_from_revision_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (reused_from_revision_id) REFERENCES spotlight_answer_revisions(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: spotlight_answers_modality_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((input_modality)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['TEXT'::character varying, 'VOICE'::character varying, 'MIXED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: spotlight_answers_no_self_reuse
constraints.definition: CHECK (((reused_from_revision_id IS NULL) OR (reused_from_revision_id <> id)))

constraints.name: spotlight_answers_numbers_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((revision_number > 0) AND (accepted_state_version > 0) AND (accepted_selection_version > 0)))

constraints.name: spotlight_answers_question_version_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (question_id, question_version) REFERENCES spotlight_questions(id, question_version) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: spotlight_answers_reuse_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((acceptance_mode)::text = 'AUTHORED'::text) AND (reused_from_revision_id IS NULL) AND (reuse_snapshot IS NULL)) OR (((acceptance_mode)::text = 'CONFIRMED_REUSE'::text) AND (reuse_snapshot IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(reuse_snapshot) = 'object'::text))))

constraints.name: spotlight_answers_snapshot_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(acceptance_snapshot) = 'object'::text))

constraints.name: spotlight_answers_text_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((btrim(accepted_text) <> ''::text) AND (btrim((request_key)::text) <> ''::text) AND ((request_hash)::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)))

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_current_answer_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, current_answer_number) REFERENCES spotlight_answer_revisions(question_id, revision_number) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_kind_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((kind)::text = 'BASE'::text) AND (parent_answer_revision_id IS NULL)) OR (((kind)::text = 'FOLLOW_UP'::text) AND (parent_answer_revision_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_parent_answer_revision_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parent_answer_revision_id) REFERENCES spotlight_answer_revisions(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_retirement_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((retired_at IS NULL) AND (retired_reason IS NULL)) OR ((retired_at IS NOT NULL) AND (retired_reason IS NOT NULL) AND ((retired_reason)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DESELECTED'::character varying, 'NO_VALID_SOURCE'::character varying, 'SCOPE_CHANGED'::character varying, 'PARENT_REANSWERED'::character varying, 'POLICY_CHANGED'::character varying])::text[])))))

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_snapshot_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(context_snapshot) = 'object'::text))

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_spotlight_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (spotlight_id) REFERENCES product_spotlights(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_text_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((meaning_key)::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (btrim(wording) <> ''::text) AND (btrim((prompt_version)::text) <> ''::text) AND (btrim((policy_version)::text) <> ''::text)))

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_version_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((question_version > 0) AND (state_version >= 0) AND ((current_answer_number IS NULL) OR (current_answer_number > 0))))

constraints.name: spotlight_answers_snapshot_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(acceptance_snapshot) = 'object'::text))

constraints.name: spotlight_answers_text_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((btrim(accepted_text) <> ''::text) AND (btrim((request_key)::text) <> ''::text) AND ((request_hash)::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)))

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_current_answer_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, current_answer_number) REFERENCES spotlight_answer_revisions(question_id, revision_number) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_kind_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((kind)::text = 'BASE'::text) AND (parent_answer_revision_id IS NULL)) OR (((kind)::text = 'FOLLOW_UP'::text) AND (parent_answer_revision_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_parent_answer_revision_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parent_answer_revision_id) REFERENCES spotlight_answer_revisions(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_retirement_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((retired_at IS NULL) AND (retired_reason IS NULL)) OR ((retired_at IS NOT NULL) AND (retired_reason IS NOT NULL) AND ((retired_reason)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DESELECTED'::character varying, 'NO_VALID_SOURCE'::character varying, 'SCOPE_CHANGED'::character varying, 'PARENT_REANSWERED'::character varying, 'POLICY_CHANGED'::character varying])::text[])))))

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_snapshot_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(context_snapshot) = 'object'::text))

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_spotlight_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (spotlight_id) REFERENCES product_spotlights(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_text_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((meaning_key)::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (btrim(wording) <> ''::text) AND (btrim((prompt_version)::text) <> ''::text) AND (btrim((policy_version)::text) <> ''::text)))

constraints.name: spotlight_questions_version_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((question_version > 0) AND (state_version >= 0) AND ((current_answer_number IS NULL) OR (current_answer_number > 0))))
